evidenceType: Read-only query of retained provider-free preflight; no domain mutation or model call
query: SELECT json_build_object('database',current_database(),'versionName',v.version,'documentId',d."documentId",'sourceSha256',d."sourceSha256",'sourceUrl',d."sourceUrl",'sourceVersionId',v.id,'chunks',(SELECT count(*) FROM "LegalDocumentChunk" c WHERE c."legalSourceVersionId"=v.id)) FROM "LegalSourceVersion" v JOIN "LegalSourceDocument" d ON d."legalSourceVersionId"=v.id WHERE v.id='6887d934-139f-4e16-8a05-c5f897a57661';
rootCause: fixture_chunks.py returns sourceSha256, but live harness passes no sourceSha256 to seedLegalSource; seedLegalSource writes contentHash(name) instead of the actual source bytes digest. Per-chunk/support hashes can still pass, masking the document-level mismatch.
requiredFix: Pass the verified fixture sourceSha256 into the shared seeder, persist it as the document digest, and add a provider-free regression proving it equals the source bytes and not the fixture name. Recheck only the affected provenance/preflight gates on a new immutable candidate.
